93585fa95657cab9.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Clearance Management Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The specialist will be responsible for obtaining Release Orders for all shipments, adhering to strict deadlines, and managing critical documentation and payments. Key Responsibilities Receive, prepare, and encode Customs Clearance Data to facilitate demurrage-free customs clearance. Handle and ensure the safe delivery of documents and cheques to the relevant department. Process shipping payments and fees to shipping companies to secure delivery orders. Assure the issuance of inspection, unloading, and export zone MAWANEE Invoices for payment preparation. Clear all Abdul Latif Jameel (ALJ) shipments, including parts and accessories, in accordance with IMC KPI and time-bound deadlines. Enter Import Shipment Data (E-Bayan) into port systems (FASAH website) and print Customs Doc. Ref Numbers. Verify that agency vessel manifests have been uploaded to Saudi EDI (FASAH website) via IMC expeditors. Print Port Charges/DPWJED Documents (Sadad invoice) on time at the port for containers and shipments. Obtain periodical Delivery Orders from shipping agents for parts and accessories. Manage the receiving and delivery of Original Bill of Lading (OBL) from Treasury to the shipping agent. Obtain Release Orders on time by encoding customs data and processing payments for customs duties and port charges to prevent fines and surcharges. Attach delivery orders and Custom Doc. Ref Numbers in the FASAH website for parts and accessories. Submit the FINAL BAYAN letter / GATE EXIT PASS with a serial number, issued by Saudi Customs upon payment, to transportation agencies for container retrieval from the seaport. Communicate and coordinate with IMC Import Office Coordinators regarding new shipments. Liaise externally with Saudi Customs, shipping agents, and port authorities. Coordinate with the Documenter for Customs Payment and Sadad (Port Charges) to ensure timely Release Orders. Performance Indicators Delivery of required documents within 7 to 14 days. Completion of tasks three days before shipment arrival. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Advanced knowledge of Saudi customs procedures. Functional and general expertise in container terminal activities. The role is critical in supporting the timely clearance and dispatch of all shipments, ensuring adherence to established processes and guidelines. The company also specializes in construction management, design management, estimating, cost planning, and procurement, consistently upholding standards for quality and innovation. The Role: Quantity Surveyor Junior ALEC Holdings PJSC is seeking a Quantity Surveyor Junior to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is suitable for professionals with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves contributing to high-end interiors for luxury spaces within hospitality, retail, and commercial developments, focusing on bringing design concepts to life through collaborative execution. Key Responsibilities Prepare project start-up forms and insurance documentation. Assist in preparing insurance claims and notifications for delays, loss, and expenses. Support in developing delay/disruption claims (Time and Cost). Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and quantity take-offs from drawings. Measure site progress and assist in preparing payment applications. Maintain and verify site asset registers. Assist in compiling monthly progress applications for clients. Review subcontractor payment applications and documentation. Support preparation of payments and contra charges. Contribute to monthly cost reporting and documentation. Promote effective communication within the commercial team. Uphold ALEC’s professional image at all times. Team and Work Environment The Junior Quantity Surveyor will report to the Quantity Surveyor within the Commercial Department. This role involves close collaboration with other quantity surveyors, project managers, subcontractors, and site teams to ensure accurate cost control, documentation, and reporting processes. The position offers opportunities to contribute to significant projects across Saudi Arabia and fosters a collaborative environment that values professional growth.

93a2fa16f46c1688.description: About the Role Bilfinger is seeking an experienced Planner/Scheduler to support maintenance planning and scheduling activities within refinery and petrochemical facilities in Dammam. This full-time role is critical for developing, maintaining, and optimizing maintenance schedules to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update detailed preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance schedules. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, and Support Services teams to prioritize and schedule work activities effectively. Utilize planning and scheduling tools, including Primavera P6, SAP, CMMS, and other approved systems. Monitor schedule progress, track work completion, and identify potential delays or deviations. Prepare and maintain scheduling data, reports, and performance metrics for management review. Track manpower allocation, resource availability, and work execution against approved schedules. Support schedule optimization initiatives to improve workforce productivity and equipment reliability. Generate weekly and monthly reports covering planned, completed, and overdue maintenance activities. Monitor scheduling KPIs and report performance variances. Coordinate with maintenance teams, operations personnel, and subcontractors to resolve planning and scheduling conflicts. Ensure schedule accuracy and data integrity within planning and maintenance management systems. Support turnaround and shutdown planning activities through the preparation and monitoring of detailed schedules. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or equivalent qualification. Minimum of 6 years of experience in maintenance planning and scheduling within refinery, petrochemical, oil & gas, or industrial facilities. Demonstrated leadership and coordination experience within large industrial organizations. Required Skills and Attributes Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities. Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities. High level of emotional intelligence and professional maturity. Ability to work successfully in a multicultural environment. Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement skills. Work Environment and Compliance Physically capable of conducting site visits, inspections, and plant walkdowns. Adherence to Bilfinger Code of Conduct, Anti-Corruption Policy, Reporting of Violations and Concerns Policy, and Bilfinger Life Saving Rules. Compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and all HSE procedures, standards, and site-specific safety regulations. Ability to use appropriate tools and equipment safely and wear required PPE at all times. Commitment to reporting hazards, near misses, and incidents immediately. Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety requirements, and maintain and protect Bilfinger assets and equipment. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

93af86cd91f78e4e.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, the Group has partnered with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems across their entire project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions to innovate future mobility solutions. The Role SYSTRA is seeking a Sr. Project Controls Engineer (POWER BI) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a professional with over 10 years of experience in project controls. The role involves providing specialized guidance and support for complex project control and cost management challenges, utilizing analytical skills to monitor and forecast project status, and ensuring effective financial oversight. Key Responsibilities Provide guidance and specialized assistance for resolving complex project control and cost control issues. Analyze, evaluate, and forecast project status against established baseline schedules. Establish baseline budgets for resources, revenue, and cost using an appropriate Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) in coordination with Project Managers. Analyze, evaluate, forecast, and report on cost status against the established baseline in collaboration with the planning team. Prepare and update various weekly and monthly cost tracking reports. Establish resource, revenue, and cost projections for projects in coordination with project teams. Perform variance analysis against baseline projections and recommend corrective actions. Utilize historical data and trends to maintain a realistic basis for future planning and forecasting. Monitor and track project progress, perform Earned Value Management (EVM), including calculation and reporting of EV, EAC, and ETC to assess performance and forecast final project cost. Participate in monthly and quarterly reviews, supporting the project team in explaining variances and justifications. Support the Project Director in reviewing and finalizing the business plan. Complete performance reviews for direct reports and support personnel development. Customize project control systems to meet specific project requirements. Coordinate with other departments to ensure proper cost allocation and full visibility for the project cost control function. Develop and maintain schedules for construction and design projects. Support the billing and collection process, from invoice preparation to coordinating with stakeholders for timely collection. Prepare multiple trackers and logs to monitor cost-related information and issues. Supervise and mentor Project Controls engineers as required. Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project controls. Proficiency in Power BI is essential for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

932c4be1f7ac27b2.description: About Foodics Foodics is a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment technology provider, established in 2014. Headquartered in Riyadh, the company operates across five countries, including the UAE, Egypt, Jordan, and Kuwait, serving customers and partners in over 35 countries globally. Foodics has processed over 6 billion orders and has secured $170 million in its latest funding round, marking the largest SaaS funding round in the MENA region. Role Overview The Sales Expansion Team Leader manages an outbound sales team dedicated to driving revenue growth from existing clients. This full-time role focuses on directing lead generation within the current customer base, coaching representatives on cross-selling and upselling new product lines, and executing strategies to increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). Key Responsibilities Manage incoming new branch sales requests from existing customers. Generate and send accurate quotes promptly, ensuring alignment with customer needs. Track expansion requests and ensure timely follow-ups to efficiently close deals. Identify new upselling and cross-selling opportunities from existing customers through outbound activities. Recommend additional products to maximize revenue from expansion deals. Ensure every expansion quote includes relevant upsell/cross-sell products before sending to the customer. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of expansion sales. Communicate effectively with customers regarding their expansion needs and available solutions. Maintain accurate records of expansion requests within the CRM system. Qualifications and Experience 3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or a related field. At least 2 years of experience leading a sales team. Demonstrated experience in handling sales requests and generating quotes. Proficiency in working with CRM systems to manage and track sales activities. Work Type This is a full-time position.

9370e4420b3c2aff.description: About Accor and FAENA The Red Sea Accor is expanding into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with FAENA The Red Sea, a new property focused on art, culture, and community. This venture aims to create spaces that offer authentic hospitality and transformative experiences, driven by imaginative design and a deep sense of purpose. The company is building a world that emphasizes beauty, wonder, and connection. The Role of Hygiene Officer Accor is seeking a Hygiene Officer to join the team at FAENA The Red Sea. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and is central to ensuring the highest standards of food safety and hygiene across the property. The Hygiene Officer will play a critical role in maintaining compliance with all relevant standards and regulations, contributing to a safe and healthy environment for guests and team members. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards throughout the property. Conduct regular hygiene inspections and audits in all food preparation and service areas. Monitor and maintain HACCP procedures and food safety management systems. Coordinate routine microbiological and water quality testing as required. Conduct hygiene and food safety training sessions for team members. Investigate hygiene-related incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions. Maintain hygiene records, reports, and documentation in accordance with company standards. Ensure compliance with local health and safety regulations and company policies. Work closely with the Culinary, Stewarding, and Food & Beverage teams to maintain the highest hygiene standards. Support pre-opening hygiene initiatives, audits, and operational readiness activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Hygiene Officer position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in hygiene and food safety management. A strong understanding of HACCP procedures and local health and safety regulations is essential for this role. The ability to conduct training sessions and maintain detailed records is also required. Collaboration and Environment The Hygiene Officer will operate in a collaborative environment, working closely with various operational teams including Culinary, Stewarding, and Food & Beverage. This role is integral to upholding the company's commitment to excellence in hygiene and safety standards as FAENA The Red Sea establishes its operations. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are invited to apply to contribute to the opening and ongoing success of FAENA The Red Sea.

939b28f07474b61f.company_name: مجمع صالح شكيلي المحمودي العلوي الطبي
939b28f07474b61f.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة حصه سليمان عيسى الفوزان التجارية عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم العمليات المخبرية في مركز تحاليل طبية، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على سحب العينات وإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية المختلفة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء سحب الدم بكفاءة ودقة، وهي مهارة أساسية للعمل في مركز تجميع العينات. تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب، ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز. تدوين بيانات المرضى على العينات وحفظها وفقاً لأسس الحفظ الصحيحة والمعتمدة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المختلفة والتحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج نتائج الفحوصات وتوثيقها بدقة. إتلاف العينات بعد الانتهاء من الفحوصات وتوثيق إجراءات الإتلاف المتبعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. وجود ترخيص ممارس ساري المفعول. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل في الرياض. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني المختبر الطبي ضمن مركز تحاليل طبية في مدينة الرياض، حيث يساهم في تقديم خدمات التحاليل المخبرية الأساسية. تتطلب بيئة العمل الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية لضمان جودة النتائج وسلامة العينات.

93dd4bdaa53295f6.company_name: مكتب علاء محمد علوي خرد للاستشارات الهندسية
93dd4bdaa53295f6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب رسام أرت للهندسة المدنية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريق العمل في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة في مشاريع الترميم والمحافظة على الممتلكات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات المختلفة وإدارة فريق التصميم فيما يتعلق باختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي، رسومات تفصيلية، ونماذج رقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين لضمان الالتزام بالخطط الموضوعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة، الإضافات، والتعديلات على الهياكل القائمة. معرفة بأسس ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التصميم المعماري وإعداد الرسومات والنماذج. القدرة على إدارة فريق التصميم وتوجيهه. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم المشورة والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية بدقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص في مكتب رسام أرت للهندسة المدنية، حيث سيساهم في مشاريع متنوعة تتطلب الدقة والاحترافية في التصميم والإشراف. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الرياض. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

93eef39580151c89.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Project Manager Engineering to join their team in the Eastern region. This is a full-time position with bottom-line responsibility for the financial and technical success of assigned projects. The role involves comprehensive project planning and execution for large-sized domestic and international projects, typically valued under $200 million in total installed cost. Project Leadership and Oversight The Project Manager will lead all phases of project development and delivery. This includes planning, organizing, coordinating, and controlling projects in strict adherence to established company policies, procedures, systems, and requirements. 93bc3668e4f14af3.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cashier-Food & Beverage Svcs for a full-time, non-management position at its Makkah hotel location. This role is within the Food and Beverage & Culinary category and is not remote. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Cashiering and Cash Control Responsibilities Process payment methods in accordance with established accounting procedures and policies. Adhere to property control audit standards and cash-handling procedures, including blind drops. Obtain and secure the assigned bank, verify money accuracy, and acquire change for anticipated business levels. Count the bank at the end of the shift, complete cashier reports, resolve discrepancies, drop off receipts, and secure the bank. Transport the bank to and from the assigned workstation. Welcome and acknowledge guests, anticipate and address service needs, and express genuine appreciation. Enter and locate work information using computers and/or point-of-sale systems. Support team goals and quality standards. Maintain a clean and professional appearance at all times. Protect confidential information and company assets. Perform other reasonable duties as requested by supervisors. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

934c617753d65483.description: About Laverne Group Laverne Group is a prominent retail organization operating across the beauty, cosmetics, and fashion sectors. It encompasses five distinct brands, each maintaining its unique identity, creative direction, and market positioning. The Group benefits from shared organizational structures and centralized capabilities that support overall growth, combining brand independence with organizational integration to foster a dynamic and collaborative environment. About the Role: Senior Projects Manager, Retail Projects & Expansion Laverne Group is seeking an experienced Senior Projects Manager to lead the Projects Section in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing retail branch development projects from initial planning and design through contractor coordination, execution, and final handover. The manager will also be responsible for managing design engineers and site supervisors, ensuring cost and quality control, and overseeing exhibition and event fit-out projects across the Group. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end retail branch projects, covering site assessment, cost estimation, design coordination, execution, quality control, and final handover. Manage design engineers and site supervisors, including assignment allocation and oversight of project priorities, resources, and schedules. Guide branch layouts and review 2D/3D design deliverables to ensure alignment with brand identity and operational requirements. Prepare project budgets, monitor actual costs, and evaluate variations and additional works for approval. Evaluate contractors’ technical and financial proposals, support negotiations, and coordinate project contracts with legal and relevant stakeholders. Oversee contractor and subcontractor performance, site progress, approved materials, technical quality, and project completion. Review payment claims and supplier invoices against contract terms and verified work progress, coordinating with Finance on payment follow-up. Manage exhibition and event fit-out projects, including vendor coordination, execution, cost control, quality, and handover. Prepare structured project reports, identify risks and delays, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant internal teams. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant professional experience managing retail fit-out, construction, or multi-site commercial projects. Direct team and contractor management experience. Strong knowledge of project costing, budgeting, contractor evaluation, contract coordination, and execution controls. Ability to review 2D/3D design deliverables and coordinate technical stakeholders throughout project phases. Experience in retail branch rollouts, exhibitions, or event projects is an advantage. Required Skills Strong leadership capabilities. Effective negotiation skills. Proficiency in reporting. Strong stakeholder management abilities. Proven problem-solving skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic multi-brand retail environment.

93500442a897940d.description: About the Role مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) in Al Jubail and Al Khobar, Eastern Region, is seeking an IB French Teacher. This full-time role involves developing linguistic fluency, cultural understanding, and global awareness in middle and high school students within the IB Diploma Programme framework. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on fostering intellectual curiosity and critical thinking through language. Key Responsibilities Demonstrate commitment to child protection and student safety. 93aae5db2ac36be4.description: To inspect limestone and stone materials, monitor manufacturing quality and ensure that products comply with approved drawings, samples, specifications and project requirements. The role involves supplier factory inspections, production quality checks, final inspection, documentation and coordination with suppliers and project/site teams to ensure quality compliance. Key Responsibilities 1. Raw Material Inspection Inspect incoming limestone blocks, slabs and other stone materials for quality and consistency. Check colour, texture, veining, dimensions, thickness and material condition against approved samples and specifications. Identify and report defective or unsuitable materials. 2. Production Quality Inspection Conduct pre-production, in-process and final inspections at supplier/manufacturing facilities. Monitor cutting, fabrication, finishing, polishing and edge treatment processes. Verify that products are manufactured according to approved drawings, samples and project specifications. Identify workmanship issues, production defects and technical deviations. Coordinate with suppliers and production teams on corrective actions. 3. Finished Product Inspection Inspect finished stone products for dimensional accuracy, finish, workmanship and overall quality. Verify that products meet the required project specifications before approval and dispatch. Identify, segregate and record rejected or defective materials. Maintain photographic records of inspections and defects. 4. Delivery and Site Quality Checks Verify material quantities, product identification and condition before dispatch. Check that materials are properly packed, protected and labelled to prevent transportation damage. Inspect delivered materials against approved specifications and delivery documents. Report shortages, damages, incorrect materials or quality discrepancies. Coordinate with site/project teams regarding material defects and replacement or rectification requirements. 5. Documentation and Reporting Prepare inspection reports and maintain quality records. Maintain records of material approvals, inspections, rejections and corrective actions. Prepare daily/weekly quality inspection updates. Report quality concerns, deviations and recurring defects to management. Maintain inspection checklists, delivery records and photographic documentation. Desired Candidate Profile Diploma or degree in Civil, Mechanical or relevant Engineering. 2–3 years of experience in QC/QA, preferably in limestone, natural stone or construction materials. Knowledge of stone inspection, finishing processes and technical drawings. Ability to use measuring instruments and inspection tools. Good attention to detail, reporting and coordination skills. Willingness to visit supplier factories and project sites as required.
